_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head-term for the fancy-font concept in Hungarian; use as H1/title anchor, exactly as already live on hu/index.html.
phrases.good_example: Díszes betűk, menő betűtípusok és esztétikus szimbólumok Instagram bióhoz, játék becenévhez...

phrases.usage_guidance: Both terms are used interchangeably in native content; betűtípus skews slightly more formal/technical (matches Word/LibreOffice UI term), betűstílus is the looser everyday word. Repo already alternates both correctly.
phrases.good_example: Instagram betűtípusok: szép betűk bióhoz és leíráshoz

phrases.usage_guidance: This is the term real users reach for unprompted, confirmed by an asker's own words, not a translation choice. Good as page/section head term.
phrases.good_example: Hogy lehet facebookon a nevembe olyan különleges karaktereket rakni...

phrases.native_phrase: másolás és beillesztés / másold ki és illeszd be
phrases.usage_guidance: Standard, unavoidable action pair. Repo splits it correctly: 'Másolás' as short button label, 'másold ki és illeszd be' as the fuller instruction sentence.
phrases.good_example: Kattints a Másolásra, nyisd meg a játékot, és illeszd be a névmezőbe.

phrases.usage_guidance: Core term for the nickname-generator page; distinct from felhasználónév (account @handle/login) — repo correctly uses becenév for the display/in-game name and felhasználónév for the unique account handle in the Discord guides.
phrases.good_example: Becenév Generátor: Menő Gamer Nevek & Nick Generátor

phrases.english_concept: text renders as a box/square (unsupported glyph fallback)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the 'why does my styled text look broken' troubleshooting sections; repo already applies this consistently across apro-betuk, becenev-generator, and discord-betutipusok FAQs.
phrases.good_example: Néhány betűstílus vagy ritka szimbólum nem támogatott bizonyos játékszervereken, és négyzetként (▯) jelenik meg.

phrases.register: neutral, matches Discord's own localized HU error copy
phrases.usage_guidance: This is the literal string Discord's own Hungarian client shows the user — using it verbatim is exactly right for a page that's meant to be found by someone pasting that error into a search bar.
phrases.good_example: Miért mondja a Discord, hogy érvénytelen a felhasználónevem?

phrases.usage_guidance: Direct, literal, and matches how third-party HU invisible-text tools (e.g. devtulz.com) also label it — no better native alternative exists, this is the correct term.
phrases.good_example: A trükk a láthatatlan karakter (invisible character) használata. Másold ki az üres karaktert...

phrases.usage_guidance: 'Klán' (clan, borrowed) is fully naturalized in HU gaming vocabulary; 'tag' here is the borrowed English gaming-jargon sense (short clan identifier), not the HU word 'tag' (member) — worth a disambiguating note if expanding content, since 'tag' means 'member' in plain Hungarian and could confuse a literal reader.
phrases.good_example: Rövid, könnyen megjegyezhető, tökéletes klán tagnek.
phrases.avoid_when: when writing for non-gamers (ambiguous with 'tag' = member)

phrases.english_concept: in-game rename card (paid/earned item that lets you change your username)
phrases.content_surface: editorial section (how to change your in-game name)
phrases.usage_guidance: NEW — not currently used anywhere in hu/. becenev-generator/index.html already has a 'Hogyan változtasd meg a neved a játékban' section that describes PUBG/Free Fire needing 'névváltó kártya' generically but never uses the tighter, more searched community term 'névkártya'. Worth adding as a bolded term in that section for PUBG specifically.
phrases.good_example: ha szerzel névkártyát szintlépéssel, lehet változtatni a nevet
phrases.avoid_when: for CS2/Riot games, where no card item exists — don't generalize the term across all games

phrases.english_concept: frame/wrapper symbols used to bracket a gaming nickname (꧁꧂)
phrases.usage_guidance: Repo's own FAQ correctly explains the Javanese/Rerenggan origin and gives the community nickname ('ikerernyőre hasonlítanak' — resemble a twin umbrella) — good, accurate, and matches how these are discussed internationally (rarely a native single-word HU term beyond the descriptive 'ernyő').
phrases.good_example: Ezek jávai Unicode karakterek (Rerenggan) — ꧁ balra és ꧂ jobbra —, amelyek ikerernyőre hasonlítanak.

phrases.usage_guidance: 'Nitro' stays untranslated (it's Discord's own product name); 'nélkül' (without) is the only HU word needed. Correct, minimal, matches how HU Discord users actually talk about it.
phrases.good_example: Discord betűtípusok Nitro nélkül.

phrases.english_concept: a username/handle field strips out styled Unicode characters
phrases.usage_guidance: Accurate and natural way to explain why @handles reject styled text while bio fields accept it. Used consistently across dolt-szoveg, felkover-szoveg, gotikus-betuk FAQs.
phrases.good_example: néhány @felhasználónév mező kiszűri ezeket a karaktereket — magában a félkövér szövegben nincs semmi rossz

phrases.english_concept: tasteful vs. risky (styled Discord name moderation framing)
phrases.usage_guidance: Strong, natural editorial framing native to this guide (not a borrowed structure) — correctly separates 'does it work' from 'will a mod flag it', which is the guide's whole thesis.
phrases.good_example: Egy stilizált név nem azért kockázatos, mert díszített. Akkor kockázatos, ha...

phrases.usage_guidance: 'Zalgo' is an international internet-culture term with no HU translation attempted anywhere online — correct to keep untranslated. 'Bugos' (buggy, from English 'bug') is a fully naturalized HU gaming-slang adjective, good gloss choice.
phrases.good_example: zalgo stílusúvá (bugos / glitch szöveg)

phrases.usage_guidance: 'Esztétikus' (adjective, formal-safe) is the correct choice for site-wide meta/H2 copy aimed at all ages. See HU-017 for the distinct informal noun-form register ('az én aesthetic-em') that skews younger — the two are complementary, not interchangeable; keep 'esztétikus' as the default and reserve the bare loanword 'aesthetic' for any future teen-targeted copy.
phrases.good_example: Díszes betűk, menő betűtípusok és esztétikus szimbólumok...

phrases.english_concept: 'aesthetic' as a personal-identity/style-tag noun (teen social-media register)
phrases.content_surface: not currently used on hu/ — candidate for teen-targeted copy
phrases.usage_guidance: NEW finding, not currently used as a bare noun anywhere in hu/ (site uses the adjective 'esztétikus' instead — see HU-016). Community usage is distinct: teens use 'aesthetic' itself as an untranslated noun/suffix ('hippi az aesthetic-em', 'a lakásom aesthetic-je') to mean 'my personal style/vibe', not just 'pretty'. Could be worth one teen-register sentence/FAQ entry acknowledging the loanword directly, without replacing the site's formal 'esztétikus' copy.
phrases.good_example: Szeretem az őszinte színeket és vintage ruhákat; ez az én aesthetic-em.
phrases.avoid_when: formal/meta-description copy aimed at a general adult audience — keep 'esztétikus' there

phrases.english_concept: coquette aesthetic (bows, lace, pastel, feminine-flirty style)
phrases.usage_guidance: Kept untranslated correctly — HU fashion press (Elle Hungary) also uses 'coquette' as-is, not a Hungarian gloss. Good match for the site's aesthetic-symbols section.
phrases.good_example: Esztétikus, coquette szimbólumok és díszek

phrases.usage_guidance: Kept untranslated correctly, matching how HU fashion/lifestyle press covers the trend.
phrases.good_example: Van zalgo, aláhúzott és y2k szimbólum.

phrases.english_concept: username is already taken / wanting a unique, not-yet-taken name
phrases.usage_guidance: Real, common friction point independently attested on gyakorikerdesek — good that becenev-generator already frames its unique-name section around 'Még Nem Foglalt Nevek'.
phrases.good_example: Név Szóközzel & Egyedi, Még Nem Foglalt Nevek

phrases.usage_guidance: This is the standard, dictionary/software-UI term (used identically in HU Word/LibreOffice/PowerPoint documentation) — correct, safe, no better alternative.
phrases.good_example: Apró Betűk Generátor — ᴀᴘʀᴏ ʙᴇᴛᴜᴋ és kiskapitális másoláshoz

phrases.content_surface: candidate for girls'/soft-style name-list section labels
phrases.usage_guidance: NEW — not used anywhere in hu/ (confirmed via grep, zero hits). becenev-generator's 'Lány nevek' section is currently labeled with the descriptive phrase 'Lágyabb, sok virággal & csillaggal' (softer, lots of flowers & stars) — accurate but more literary than how people actually search/ask. 'cuki' is the plain word Hungarians reach for unprompted when asking for this exact kind of name.
phrases.good_example: Tudtok mondani cuki beceneveket?

phrases.content_surface: H2 heading, alternateName in schema, editorial prose
phrases.usage_guidance: Well-attested, natural, no issues — repo uses it correctly and heavily.
phrases.good_example: Egyedi Nevek Játékhoz

phrases.usage_guidance: Correctly distinguishes the editable display-name field from the fixed @felhasználónév handle and from bió (bio) — a distinction the guide content depends on to explain where styled text does/doesn't work.
phrases.good_example: illeszd be a stilizált betűt a bióba, a profilnévbe, a leírásba és a kommentekbe.

phrases.usage_guidance: Frame Hungarian font-style content around full-diacritic support explicitly — this is a named, recurring requirement, not an assumption.
